post.description:
Create a new repository. Provide either `path` (local directory) or `remote_url` (git remote).
When `remote_url` is set, the repository is cloned into ~/git-repos/<name> first,
then the cloned path is registered. Supports https://, http://, git://, ssh://,
ftp://, ftps://, file://, and SCP-style git@ URLs.
When `path` is provided and `auto_init` is true, the directory is created and git-init'd if needed.

parameters.description: Repository details; provide path OR remote_url

auto_init.description: Pointer to distinguish between unset and false

branch.description:
Branch is the base branch the new worktree forks from. Required so the
server never silently falls back to a guessed default (e.g. "main") that
may not exist in the repo — that fallback used to leave the workspace
shell in place with no worktree on disk and the failure swallowed.

disk_drives.description: Windows drive letters, empty on Linux

personal_mode.description:
PersonalMode is true when niuniu-server runs in personal/embedded mode
(cfg.Auth.Enabled=false). Host-shell ops (open terminal, open path) are
only meaningful in this mode. Decorated by SystemDepsHandler.
